name: Bódvaszilas (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, white and blue in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bódvaszilas: a blue shield with a yellow bunch of grapes and a wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
